quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his reputation as a hard worker
quotes.excerpt: the one thing that they will never say is that I'm not a hard worker
quotes.quote: I've been called a lot of names. People talk a lot of about me. But the one thing that they will never say is that I'm not a hard worker. And so I think that's the foundation that was laid when I was being raised by my grandparents.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his high school basketball dominance
quotes.excerpt: I leave out of that camp as the number one player in the camp over LeBron
quotes.quote: I went to the ABCD camp. It was all the top names over there, LeBron, Lenny Cooke, Sebastian Telfair, Dwight Howard. I go there and I kill that. I leave out of that camp as the number one player in the camp over LeBron. For a four month window, I was ranked number one in the country.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his regrets in his playing career
quotes.excerpt: I got so many regrets in my playing career
quotes.quote: I got so many regrets in my playing career that that's why with this second career, I'm maximizing this. I got so many regrets. It's things that I could have been better at, better at. I wasn't in the gym. So I'm working. I'm working.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his growth as a media personality
quotes.excerpt: one of the greatest teammates I ever played with Nick Collison, he extended his career
quotes.quote: I always watch one of the greatest teammates I ever played with Nick Collison, he extended his career an extra three or four years because he was able to shoot the corner three. And while I was on the team with him, I used to watch him after practice shooting that corner three and I used to never jump in there.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his viral criticism of Kyrie Irving during the bubble
quotes.excerpt: You put Kyrie's brain in a bird, that bird will start flying backwards.
quotes.quote: It was during the pandemic and they were just coming back and Kyrie didn't want to play, go down to the bubble or whatever. And I did go on TV and I went too far. I was like, man, Kyrie tripping. Right now, man, you put Kyrie's brain in a bird, that bird will start flying backwards. I thought there was a low blow. It was a low blow. It was disrespectful.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his public apology to Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: I went not just in private, I publicly apologized to him.
quotes.quote: I go to Memphis game, I see Kyrie. Kyrie come up to me like, big fella, man, God bless you, how you doing? It me up. So I had to high-level him. Like, hey, bro. And then I went not just in private, I publicly apologized to him. That was just too much. It may have got some views, it may have went viral, but I didn't have to go that low.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the difference between podcasting and television
quotes.excerpt: Make sure you be prepared. Have your facts in order. Know what you're going to say.
quotes.quote: To the new media, my thing is one, it's two different platforms. If you're coming on, you're doing your own thing in the podcast space, cool, be you. Be you all day long. I'm not telling you not to be you. But all I know is when you come on television, one, make sure you be prepared. Have your facts in order. Know what you're going to say, because there ain't no cutting, edited on television. That is live.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the importance of humility for athletes
quotes.excerpt: The biggest thing is one, you got to humble yourself.
quotes.quote: You got to adjust. The biggest thing is one, you got to humble yourself. Because as athletes, as athletes and entertainers, you get to a certain level, you have that sense of entitlement and all that. Now, bro, so even if you ain't planned out your second career, you ain't on TV as much at all, so now don't really know your name. Like they kind of forgot about you.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his biggest career regret regarding networking
quotes.excerpt: The biggest fuck up that I had in my career was that I didn't network.
quotes.quote: The biggest fuck up that I had in my career was that I didn't network and value those relationships while I was playing. When you're playing, man, you meet so many people, you get their business card, you don't, you throw that away soon as you walk out the door. Now, people walking up to me, high-power, not high-power, and they like, hey Perk, I do this, I do that. I'm taking those conversations.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his induction into the Texas Basketball Hall of Fame
quotes.excerpt: The best thing that I ever got, winning the NBA championship is cool, but for all my kids.
quotes.quote: Winning the NBA championship is cool, but for all my kids got to experience with me was when I went into the Texas Basketball Hall of Fame, because that was a moment that they all got to be there. And it was like, yeah, like this what your daddy did. They see the jerseys, they watch YouTube, they don't even give a fuck. They don't turn on TV watching me, they care less.

quotes.speaker: Lil KeKe
quotes.summary_phrase: Lil KeKe on his realization that his children's milestones were his greatest assets
quotes.excerpt: Every graduation, every tear, every pamper change, every football game, every baseball, every soccer kick.
quotes.quote: I used to sit back in my career and I used to miss parties and I missed the BET Awards. And one day I just woke up and realized that everything that they had done, every graduation, every tear, every pamper change, every football game, every baseball, every soccer kick, I seen all that shit. And I realized that that was one of my greatest assets. That was one of my biggest accolades ever.
